Modega is introducing our own community class series, but with a twist! Every other weekend, we will have a fun intermediate/advanced level choreo session led by choreographers looking to get more teaching experience—or just share. Afterward, instead of rushing you all out, we welcome you to stay! Build community, drink (21+), game night, meet new people, all of it! 18+ to participate. 1/3 of all revenue benefits an organization of choice. This week:
